name: 2-Block Littlestone Dimension of the Cube–Half-interval Product
details: For $m\ge1,n\ge2$. Block and prefix formulas hold for fixed integer $k\ge2$; the general block catalogue entry uses $k>2$. Asymptotic orders refer to $n\to\infty$ with $m,k$ fixed.
proof: Specialize the general $k$-block calculation for this same family (value record 1082) to $k=2$: its argument applies to every integer $k\ge2$, even though that catalogue parameter is indexed by $k>2$.
references: Direct finite product calculation; independent exact regression in sync/verify_cube_halfinterval_trees.py.
